description: This file defines the ChatFragment class, a UI component for a conversational chat interface in an Android app. It manages message display, user input, quick prompt chips, and simulates AI responses.

classes.name: ChatFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides a chat UI with message history, quick prompts, and AI response simulation.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: A data class representing a chat message, including text, sender indicator, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter managing the display of chat messages with different layouts for sent and received messages.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the chat fragment UI layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up message list, adds quick prompt chips, and handles send button click to simulate AI responses.

methods.name: addPromptChip
methods.description: Creates and adds a quick prompt chip to a ChipGroup with an associated click handler.

methods.name: addUserMessage
methods.description: Adds a user message to the message list and updates the RecyclerView.

methods.name: addAiMessage
methods.description: Adds an AI message to the message list and updates the RecyclerView.

methods.name: ChatAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates item view for chat message.

methods.name: ChatAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds message data to view holder, toggling visibility based on sender.
